comment: Timed voiceover script for the CrimePsych (30s @ 30fps) video. `start` is in seconds and is aligned to the scene timeline. This one file drives (a) the optional generated voiceover track and (b) the optional burned-in captions, so audio and captions always stay in sync.

voice.recommended: calm, measured, low-timbre true-crime narrator; unhurried; pause before reveals

lines.text: It's the psychology of crime and horror.
Morbid curiosity isn't a flaw. It's an adaptation.
Your brain, rehearsing danger from the safety of your couch.
Fear becomes a thrill through a paradox.
The alarm fires, the mind says you're safe, and dread turns into a high.
And the core audience? Women. Nearly twice as often as men.
The craft is simple. Suspense over surprise.
Sound scares more than the image. Open a loop, then close it.
But one rule holds above all. Center the victim, not the killer.
Because the ethical path is the one that lasts.
